infoCompanyBusinessSummary.title: Business Summary
infoCompanyBusinessSummary.body: Lanka Credit and Business Finance Limited (LCBF) is a licensed finance company regulated by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka mainly focuses on Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) clients. Their product portfolio includes savings accounts, personalized leasing solutions, gold loans, loans for business, education loans, housing loans, revolving credit, Micro loans and investment accounts with optional investment plans.
